name: Criterion 4: Observability & Tracing Evaluation Set
description: Evaluates OpenTelemetry compliance, distributed tracing spans, latency performance, and audit trails.

eval_cases.name: OpenTelemetry Granular Lifecycle Spans
eval_cases.description: Verifies that all lifecycle actions emit structured spans with duration_ms, type, and details.

rubrics.description: Every major action must record an OTel-compliant span in the telemetry buffer.

eval_cases.name: Distributed Trace Context Propagation
eval_cases.description: Verifies that unique audit trace IDs are propagated across tool invocations, resolution records, and disputes.

rubrics.description: Atomic resolution result must contain a traceable audit_trace_id.

eval_cases.name: Execution Latency & Performance SLA
eval_cases.description: Verifies that agent synthesis and tool execution complete well within the sub-second latency SLA (<500ms).

rubrics.description: Agent turn execution must complete within 500ms under local testing.

eval_cases.name: Telemetry PII & PCI-DSS Audit Trail Redaction
eval_cases.description: Verifies that telemetry spans, log files, and traces do not leak plain credit card PANs or customer passwords.

rubrics.description: Telemetry buffer must remain 100% free of unmasked sensitive payment or identity data.
